Attention.description: Whether a perceived event is noticed at all (memory.encode).

default.description: Probability of noticing an event of any kind not listed in by_kind.
default.title: Default

by_kind.description: Per event kind override of default. Kills, bodies and meetings are always noticed.
by_kind.title: By Kind

Attention.title: Attention

Encoding.description: How much of a noticed event is kept, and how faithfully (memory.encode).

fidelity.description: Probability of keeping each detail (room, actor, target, text); also the share of a chat message's words kept. Raised by 0.3 for kills and bodies.
fidelity.title: Fidelity

detail_noise.description: Probability that a kept room is remembered as a neighbouring room instead.
detail_noise.title: Detail Noise

Encoding.title: Encoding

EventKind.description: What an agent can perceive. Objective-only facts have no member here.
EventKind.title: EventKind

Judgement.description: How recalled evidence turns into suspicion (beliefs.update_beliefs).

suspicion_bias.description: Multiplier on incriminating evidence; exonerating evidence is not scaled.
suspicion_bias.title: Suspicion Bias

Judgement.title: Judgement

Retention.description: How long a trace stays recallable (memory.strength, memory.recall).

half_life_ticks.description: Ticks until a trace's strength halves. Doubled for kills and bodies.
half_life_ticks.title: Half Life Ticks

recall_threshold.description: Minimum strength for a trace to come to mind. Below half of it, the trace is deleted.
recall_threshold.title: Recall Threshold

Retention.title: Retention

Voice.description: How the agent speaks (decide prompt, validator).

max_words.description: Upper bound on words per meeting statement.
max_words.title: Max Words

Voice.title: Voice

description: One ego file. ``ego_id`` comes from the file name, never from the file.

persona.description: Character description; becomes part of the trusted instructions.
persona.title: Persona
